sentences.en: When I was little, I supposedly ate nothing but peaches.
sentences.zh: 我小时候据说只吃桃子。

sentences.en: The peaches at the bottom of the basket are rotten.
sentences.zh: 篮子里底部的桃子烂了。

sentences.en: Have you ever greeted the small peach tree in German?
sentences.zh: 你用德语问候过那棵小桃树吗？

phrases.zh: 桃仁（指桃子和杏仁一起使用或提及）

senses.zh: 桃子；桃树；桃红色；受人喜欢的人（或物）
